title: TAI bootstrap preflight authority
objective: Break the circular TAI release dependency by accepting only the exact safe standalone-runtime materialization blockers as bootstrap-eligible after every infrastructure, model, PostgreSQL and mutation-guard prerequisite has passed; retain strict zero-blocker post-deployment authority.
boundaries: Bootstrap eligibility requires exactly TAI_SERVICE_NOT_MATERIALIZED, TAI_DEDICATED_ENV_NOT_MATERIALIZED and TAI_DEDICATED_DB_PRINCIPAL_NOT_ATTESTED
All critical compose, exact-runtime, capacity, model-connectivity, TAI schema/profile and no-mutation checks must be PASS
Any additional, missing-authority, malformed or mutation-related blocker fails closed
Model admission remains a separately reported maturity state and is never fabricated
The owner command, exact-current-main image, immutable digest, non-root image user and protected REG.RU controller remain mandatory
Standalone deployment must still finish with a strict zero-blocker postflight
